name: vividwireless
summary: Retail 4G/WiMAX wireless broadband brand launched by the Seven Group on Unwired's network (2010); acquired by Optus from Seven in 2012 (A$230M); service ceased April 2019.

events.details: Announced 2009 as Seven's retail front for Unwired's 4G network.
Services ceased; shifted to Optus 4G Plus brand.
